findings.reason: The universality claim says every finite-dimensional unitary channel, while its QSD supplier proves synthesis on ordered n-qubit registers of dimension 2^n (and the 0-qubit identity channel). State that domain explicitly.
Circuit syntax indexes wires 0 through n−1, but the schedule uses 1 through n without giving the correspondence. State j↔circuit wire j−1 and use it consistently in the encoding.
The graph vertices and frame recurrences use 1-based wire indices; specify their correspondence to the ordered circuit wires so the encoded branch maps use the same factor order.
The definition multiplies CZ operators on the full register but gives only their two-qubit matrices. Cite or define the full-register local embedding, including the ordered factors.
The input insertion and tensor product of measurement bras are linear maps; make their ordered construction explicit and include the tensor-map supplier.

The matching lemma uses A_Mx and binary dot products without stating their coordinate conventions. The same gap occurs in lem-qc-graph-state-stabilizer-generators and def-qc-circuit-to-graph-resource-encoding; cite the matrix-product and binary-dot conventions or give the coordinate formulas and wire order.

The induction introduces prefix maps K_c and contractions L_b without defining them from the full branch-map formula. Define the recursive maps and verify that the terminal map is the stated K_b before applying completeness and trace preservation.

consumer_checks.reason: Its objective summarizes universality without the n-qubit domain; align that nonlogical use with the corrected theorem scope.
